default.notes: A consular visa is required before travel, and some nationalities also need a 'consulted' authorisation from immigration headquarters. El Salvador's exemption list is broad — confirm your passport's status with Migración or a consulate before booking. A valid US visa generally allows entry with the tourist card instead.

groups.notes: CA-4 free movement — citizens of Guatemala, Honduras and Nicaragua enter El Salvador with a national ID card and no visa; the four countries form one migration zone.

Visa-free for up to 90 days, shared across the CA-4 zone (El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras, Nicaragua). Many nationalities — including the US and Canada — pay USD 12 for a tourist card on arrival; others are fee-exempt.

SV.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Salvadoran citizens.

CN.notes: Chinese citizens need a consular visa — no waiver followed El Salvador's 2018 switch of recognition to Beijing. Holders of a valid US visa are generally admitted with the USD 12 tourist card instead.
